acceptance_criteria: Business Mode is the default and asks only material questions in business language; ordinary visual, page, hierarchy, grouping, layout, interaction and compiler choices remain GPT-4.1 BI-design decisions.
Advanced or BI Mode uses the same reasoning architecture and accepts optional supported technical preferences without requiring the user to manually design the report; no third mode is introduced.

A typed bounded state model distinguishes REQUEST, ANALYSING, NEEDS_CLARIFICATION, READY_FOR_CONFIRMATION, CONFIRMED, HUMAN_REVIEW_REQUIRED, UNSUPPORTED and OUT_OF_SCOPE from provider, authentication, corrupt-input, compiler and infrastructure failures.

Every clarification round receives the original request, exact schema context, applicable governed context, current structured interpretation, prior questions, prior raw and interpreted answers and unresolved ambiguities.

Configured question and clarification-round limits are deterministic safety boundaries; this task does not invent an unaccepted numeric value, and exhausted limits with material ambiguity transition to HUMAN_REVIEW_REQUIRED without assumption.

Suggested options and bounded natural-language answers are supported; raw answers remain immutable provenance, GPT-4.1 alone proposes structured meaning, and deterministic TypeScript never parses arbitrary prose into business semantics.

A concise Confirm or Correct step presents material business meaning before it becomes authoritative; correction returns to analysis and only human-confirmed structured semantics enter ConfirmedRequirementContract.

Business confirmation covers objective and questions, material KPI or calculation definitions, scope and time meaning, important dimensions and filters, lifecycle or status meaning and material policy decisions, but not every ordinary report-design choice.

Applicable knowledge is retrieved for clarification and again for report design and is explicitly classified as PLATFORM_POLICY, TENANT_GOVERNED or DEMO_FIXTURE; retrieval cannot authorize or silently override an explicit user requirement, and material mandatory-policy conflicts are surfaced.

After confirmation GPT-4.1 receives the confirmed contract, exact schema, applicable governed knowledge, interaction mode and supported-capability profile and remains responsible for ordinary supported report-design choices without certifying its own output.

Deterministic code enforces universal security, provenance, state, limit, schema, field, measure, typed-calculation, contract, preservation, capability, geometry, compiler, artifact and terminal-state invariants without becoming a BI architect.

No universal KPI-to-card, trend-to-line, filter-to-slicer, one-chart-per-dimension, co-location, field-name, KPI-name, report-type, page-recipe or business-calculation rule is introduced unless an explicit confirmed requirement, tenant policy or compiler limitation requires it.

Layout or capability conflicts may produce AI-proposed supported alternatives; material changes return to clarification and confirmation, while insisted unsatisfiable requirements become HUMAN_REVIEW_REQUIRED or UNSUPPORTED.

Synthetic service or operations, sales or performance, marketing or effectiveness and customer or retention fixtures use one production path and prove adaptive clarification, a genuine follow-up, both modes, natural-language interpretation, confirmation-before-authority, exact typed contract and safe unresolved behavior.
Static genericity checks and fresh independent review reject both literal and disguised scenario-specific production prompts, branches, field or KPI assumptions and design recipes.

Existing valid APBRA-143 version-one one-round contracts remain valid and readable or use an explicit deterministic compatibility path; all APBRA-138, APBRA-139, APBRA-141, APBRA-142 and APBRA-143 safety controls remain effective.
